It’s still decent in October if you want to take advantage of some cool dolphin fishing in the fall.. Book Now to secure your spot on Sea Teaser. Various baits can be used. Artificial Lures including offshore trolling lures, as well as ballyhoo, squid, and cut bait. Dolphin are found offshore.
